body.summary: Production hardening complete: DSH client resilience (retry, circuit breaker, health checks), plugin health endpoints (/health, /ready, /metrics), event-driven CNS watcher, 20 tests passing, performance targets met
components_delivered: DSHClient with exponential backoff retry (configurable max_attempts, base_delay, max_delay, exponential_base)
CircuitBreaker with Closed/Open/HalfOpen states, configurable failure/success thresholds and timeout
HealthCheckResult with latency, circuit state, endpoint status, timestamp, error details
Axum-based HTTP health server with Prometheus metrics exposition
Event-driven CNS watcher (notify crate) replacing polling
9 new resilience tests: circuit breaker lifecycle, retry config, health check serialization, DSH client creation

performance.note: DSH in-memory translation is 2x FASTER than CNS JSON serialization
